mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_order WHERE del_flag='0') AS totalOrders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_order WHERE del_flag='0' AND DATE(create_time)=CURDATE()) AS todayOrders, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount),0) FROM takeout_order WHERE del_flag='0' AND DATE(create_time)=CURDATE() AND status IN ('1','2','3','4','5')) AS todayRevenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_user WHERE del_flag='0') AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_rider WHERE del_flag='0') AS totalRiders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_rider WHERE del_flag='0' AND status='0') AS onlineRiders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_merchant WHERE del_flag='0') AS totalMerchants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_complaint WHERE del_flag='0' AND status='0') AS pendingComplaints, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_dispatch WHERE del_flag='0' AND status IN ('1','2')) AS activeDispatches

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount),0) AS revenue FROM takeout_order WHERE del_flag='0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT m.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount),0) AS totalRevenue FROM takeout_merchant m LEFT JOIN takeout_order o ON m.merchant_id = o.merchant_id AND o.del_flag='0' AND o.status IN ('1','2','3','4','5') WHERE m.del_flag='0' GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.dish_id AS dishId, d.dish_name AS dishName, IFNULL(SUM(i.quantity),0) AS totalQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(i.subtotal),0) AS totalAmount FROM takeout_dish d LEFT JOIN takeout_order_item i ON d.dish_id = i.dish_id LEFT JOIN takeout_order o ON i.order_id = o.order_id AND o.del_flag='0' AND o.status IN ('1','2','3','4','5') WHERE d.del_flag='0' GROUP BY d.dish_id, d.dish_name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.rider_id AS riderId, r.name AS riderName, r.phone AS phone, COUNT(d.dispatch_id) AS deliveryCount, r.rating AS rating FROM takeout_rider r LEFT JOIN takeout_dispatch d ON r.rider_id = d.rider_id AND d.del_flag='0' AND d.status='3' WHERE r.del_flag='0' GROUP BY r.rider_id, r.name, r.phone, r.rating ORDER BY deliveryCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_order WHERE del_flag='0' AND DATE(create_time)=CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount),0) FROM takeout_order WHERE del_flag='0' AND DATE(create_time)=CURDATE() AND status IN ('1','2','3','4','5')
